title: Te Kaitiaki o te Mura e kore e tineia
intro: Kei te paepae o te wāhi tino wehingia i te ao ngaro tētahi āhua, kua tukua ki a ia tētahi mahi kāore i hiahiatia e tētahi atu. Ina karanga ngā wairua mamae mō te aroha, ka rangona he whakautu pakari i roto i ngā rūma ahi. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei kaitiaki mutunga kore?
clues: E tū ana ahau i te tomokanga o tētahi wāhi whiu whakamataku, i te wāhi e kore e kitea.
He ahi e mura ana, e kore e tineia, te kaupapa matua o taku mahi tapu.
E karanga ana ngā wairua mamae ki tōku ingoa, e inoi ana kia whakaorangia rātou i tō rātou whakamamae mutunga kore.
Ina inoi rātou, ka kī atu ahau e kore rātou e haere atu, ake tonu atu.
Ehara ahau i te tangata, ehara hoki i te jinn — he mea hanga ahau me te ngohengohe parakore.
Ko ahau te anahera matua kua whakaritea hei kaitiaki mutunga kore o te Ahi Reinga.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: E inoi ana te iwi o te reinga kia mutu tō rātou whakamamae
Ka whakatangihia te tetere hei tohu mō te Rā Whakawa
Kua whakakitea te Quran ki te ngākau o te Poropiti
Ka makaia tētahi Poropiti ki roto i te ahi nui e tōna iwi
Ka hangaia he taiepa kaha hei pupuri i tētahi iwi pirau
trial.answer: E inoi ana te iwi o te reinga kia mutu tō rātou whakamamae

outcome.label: Hua
options: E kīia ana ki ngā tāngata o te Reinga ka noho tonu rātou ake ake
Ka murua te hara o te hunga e noho ana i te reinga, ā, ka tukuna
Ka tukuna he whai wāhitanga tuarua ki te hunga e noho ana i te reinga ki te whakapono
Ka nekehia ngā tāngata o te reinga ki te wāhi matao
Ka whakangaromia rawatia ngā tāngata o te Reinga e te whatitiri
outcome.answer: E kīia ana ki ngā tāngata o te Reinga ka noho tonu rātou ake ake

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
